name: Runner Extras - static Report Run RunModal unresolvable id
brief: Static Report.Run(id, ...) / Report.RunModal(id, ...) must fail LOUDLY, not silently no-op, when the runner cannot resolve a report id.
description: History (#1771): static Report.RunModal(Report::X, ...) silently did nothing (no dataset iteration, no OnPostReport, no error) instead of either executing the report or throwing. Root cause was a JmpHook (AlRunner/Patches/ReportPatches.cs) that never actually fired under the default Cecil-only runtime, so the call fell through the Cecil-blanked `ret` body. Resolvable report ids now execute for real (that positive claim is plain BC behaviour and belongs in the al-language corpus, not here). This suite pins the one genuinely runner-specific edge the fix leaves behind: an id the runner's own metadata cache can never learn (nothing in the loaded assemblies declares it) must still surface loudly via RunnerOutOfScopeException, never as a quiet success.
